description: Department of Census and Statistics - The Colombo Consumers' Price Index for the month of February, 2015 was 178.9
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the Colombo Consumers' Price Index for February 2015, which is a statistical economic indicator published by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) nor does it fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters). As statistical reporting of economic indicators doesn't fall under Types 4-9, it is classified as Miscellaneous (Type 10).
